notes.title: Distribution of "Livestream 2: Escape from Togaezuka Happy Place" begins!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34134139/2ad1b0924db837b86bf6ee3db0642f045589e9b4.png[/img]

Can you escape the horror of being hunted down...?
The sequel to the survival horror game "Livestream: Escape from Hotel Izanami" is finally here!

It's a side-scrolling survival action-adventure game in which players must escape from a mysterious mascot in an abandoned shopping mall, using items and hints as clues. Depending on the player's choices, the fate of the girls will drastically change.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278630/2/

notes.title: 『The Future You've Been Dreaming Of』July 15, 2022 Release（Japan time）
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34134139/580f92e4bffb3420f94a5adb96bf43d5d1a064f0.png[/img]

Take on the role of a Zashiki-Warashi, a house-bound spirit that can bring good fortune, and peer into Sachi's life (though she can't see you). You'll see some of her more vulnerable moments and have no choice but to intervene from time to time, but it's all to guide her toward a bright future!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885130/
